support_text: Need help? Contact support or follow updates.
duration_invalid: Use a duration from 1 minute to 7 days.
media_blocked: Media is restricted during your new-member protection period.
nsfw_removed: Inappropriate media detected. Media removed and user muted.
help_protection: New-member probation, media restriction, automatic expiry, whitelist and admin bypass.
help_members: Configure new-member protection, duration and whitelist.
help_nsfw: Optional real classifier integration for photos/videos/GIFs. Flagged media is deleted and the sender is muted.
help_flood: Detect rapid message bursts and automatically delete, warn, mute or ban repeat offenders.
help_link: Remove unauthorized links from protected groups.
help_warnings: Warn users; automatic mute and repeat-offender ban thresholds are configurable.
help_lockdown: Emergency mode: restrict normal users while admins retain control.
help_commands: Admin commands: /status /config /duration 24h /newmember on /antilink on /antiflood on /nsfw on /lockdown on /warn /unwarn /warnings /whitelist /unwhitelist /setbadword /delbadword /badwords
